mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.25%) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 9.0% for two consecutive months indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger recessionary fears, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC for UNRATE threshold signal falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction signal remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO above 105.0) signals easing supply chain constraints and manufacturing expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through improved corporate earnings visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or Rank IC for INDPRO signal falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly real GDP expansion (GDPC1 above 1.5% annualized) indicates strengthening economic fundamentals that support corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 1.5% annualized, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent inflation that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to immediate rate hike expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC for CPI threshold signal falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL above 3.0%) indicate active monetary tightening to combat inflation, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through higher discount rates.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL above 3.0% fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction signal remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong labor market growth (PAYEMS increasing by more than 100,000 jobs monthly) boosts consumer spending and corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through accelerated earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000 jobs, or Rank IC for PAYEMS signal falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.
